parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of multiple INSERTs when saving a model instance with an explicit pk value if the pk field has a default. However, it introduces a potential behavioral regression risk.

issues.description: The patch changes the behavior of the save method, which may break existing code that relies on the previous behavior of performing an UPDATE when the primary key has a default and the instance is being added.
